# form.addTextField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Add a text field to the current form.

```lua
form.addTextField(line, rect, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current text |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on text change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addTextField(line, nil, function() return text end, function(newValue) text = newValue end)
form.addTextField(line, {x=200, y=0, w=100, h=40}, function() return text end, function(newValue) text = newValue end)
form.addTextField(line, form.getFieldSlots(line, {100, 0, "slot3"})[0], function() return text end, function(newValue) text = newValue end)
```

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 4 times across 4 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    control = form.addTextField(form.addLine("@i18n(app.modules.configuration.craft_name)@"), textFieldPos(app),
        function()
            return state.currentName
        end,
        function(newValue)
            local value = tostring(newValue or "")
            if value ~= state.currentName then
                state.currentName = value
                state.dirty = true
                app:setPageDirty(true)
            end
        end)
    ```

    <small>[src/rfsuite/app/modules/configuration/configuration.lua:663](https://github.com/robthomson/ethos-app-framework/blob/fdfd6e70f8f2865a2742102e009b791ae18e3ca9/src/rfsuite/app/modules/configuration/configuration.lua#L663-L674)</small>

=== "Example 2"

    ```lua
    -- header comment for why: the first page needing one, and why it
    -- can't be corrected in place like every other field type).
    local nameLine = form.addLine("@i18n(app.modules.configuration.craft_name)@")
    local nameField = form.addTextField(nameLine, nil,
      function()
        local craftName = dataRef.data.craftName
        return craftName and craftName.name or ""
      end,
      function(value)
        markDirty()
        local craftName = dataRef.data.craftName
        if craftName then craftName.name = value or "" end
      end)
    ```

    <small>[src/rfsuite/app/pages/configuration.lua:228](https://github.com/rotorflight/rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite/blob/53c7e819afe6293cb7623b5972e4a4d276a90ad1/src/rfsuite/app/pages/configuration.lua#L228-L240)</small>

=== "Example 3"

    ```lua
    formFields[i] = form.addTextField(formLines[dashx.session.formLineCnt], posField, function()
        if not fields or not fields[i] then
            ui.disableAllFields()
            ui.disableAllNavigationFields()
            ui.enableNavigationField('menu')
            return nil
        end
        return dashx.app.utils.getFieldValue(fields[i])
    end, function(value)
        if f.postEdit then f.postEdit(page) end
        if f.onChange then f.onChange(page) end
    
        f.value = dashx.app.utils.saveFieldValue(fields[i], value)
    end)
    ```
